candidates.name: Shopee
candidates.description: Both are key components of the Sea group ecosystem, with Shopee serving as the primary e-commerce marketplace platform.
candidates.rationale: Shopee is Sea’s own core e-commerce subsidiary, not a distinct lookalike company for prospecting.

candidates.name: GCash Group
candidates.description: Both operate as leading digital financial services and mobile wallet platforms providing comprehensive payment and financial solutions to Southeast Asian consumers.
candidates.rationale: GCash overlaps SeaMoney’s core mobile-wallet, payments, and consumer financial-services offering for Southeast Asian users.

candidates.name: GoTo Group
candidates.description: Like Sea, GoTo combines e-commerce and financial technology services to create a comprehensive digital ecosystem in Southeast Asia.
candidates.rationale: Both operate Southeast Asian consumer ecosystems combining e-commerce marketplaces and digital financial services for overlapping merchants and consumers.

candidates.name: Grab
candidates.description: Operates a similar super-app model in Southeast Asia, integrating transport, delivery, and digital financial services.
candidates.rationale: Grab’s core ride-hailing and delivery marketplace does not overlap Shopee’s primary e-commerce marketplace job, despite both offering digital payments.

candidates.name: MercadoLibre, Inc.
candidates.description: Acts as the dominant e-commerce and fintech ecosystem provider in Latin America, mirroring Sea's multi-platform strategy.
candidates.rationale: Both operate consumer e-commerce marketplaces and integrated digital financial services ecosystems, serving overlapping merchant and consumer needs in different regions.

candidates.name: Lazada
candidates.description: Provides a large-scale e-commerce marketplace across Southeast Asia, competing directly with Sea's core retail business.
candidates.rationale: Lazada directly overlaps Shopee as a Southeast Asian e-commerce marketplace serving the same merchants and consumers.

candidates.name: Tencent
candidates.description: Shares deep historical ties and business DNA with Sea, operating a broad ecosystem of digital entertainment, social, and financial services.
candidates.rationale: Both operate consumer internet ecosystems with core digital gaming and financial-services products competing for overlapping users and use cases.

candidates.name: Kakao
candidates.description: Operates a diversified technology ecosystem including messaging, e-commerce, and fintech platforms in the Asian market.
candidates.rationale: Both operate Asian consumer technology ecosystems with overlapping e-commerce and fintech platforms serving similar users and commercial partners.

candidates.name: Paytm
candidates.description: Offers an integrated digital payment and financial service ecosystem, similar to the scope of SeaMoney.
candidates.rationale: Paytm’s consumer and merchant payments ecosystem overlaps SeaMoney, serving similar users for digital payments and financial services.

candidates.name: Kaspi
candidates.description: Known as a leading super-app that successfully integrates e-commerce, payments, and fintech, paralleling Sea's business model.
candidates.rationale: Kaspi closely parallels Sea with an integrated consumer super-app spanning e-commerce, payments, and digital financial services for consumers and merchants.

candidates.name: JD.com
candidates.description: A major e-commerce retail platform that provides logistics and supply chain services similar to Shopee's fulfillment infrastructure.
candidates.rationale: JD.com and Shopee both operate large e-commerce marketplaces with seller services, fulfillment, logistics, and consumer shopping platforms.

candidates.name: Naver Corp
candidates.description: Diversified technology company with significant presence in e-commerce, digital payments, and content platforms.
candidates.rationale: Both operate consumer internet ecosystems centered on e-commerce marketplaces, digital payments, and content, serving overlapping shoppers and online merchants.

candidates.name: Flipkart Group
candidates.description: A leading e-commerce retailer that has expanded into broad consumer services and payments in the Asian market.
candidates.rationale: Flipkart and Shopee both operate major consumer e-commerce marketplaces with adjacent digital payments and services in Asian markets.

candidates.name: Coupang
candidates.description: A major e-commerce marketplace known for its integrated logistics and consumer-centric technology services.
candidates.rationale: Both operate major consumer e-commerce marketplaces with technology-enabled shopping and logistics, serving overlapping merchants and consumers.

candidates.name: Daraz Group
candidates.description: An e-commerce and logistics marketplace operating in South Asia, following a similar regional integration strategy to Sea.
candidates.rationale: Daraz and Shopee both operate regional consumer e-commerce marketplaces with integrated logistics, serving similar merchants and online shoppers.

candidates.name: Rakuten
candidates.description: Operates an extensive ecosystem encompassing e-commerce, digital payments, and fintech services.
candidates.rationale: Rakuten and Sea both operate consumer e-commerce marketplaces alongside digital payments and fintech services, serving overlapping merchants and consumers.

candidates.name: Maya
candidates.description: Provides an integrated digital wallet and banking services platform, acting as a direct fintech competitor in the Southeast Asian market.
candidates.rationale: Maya’s digital wallet and banking platform overlaps Sea’s core digital financial services, serving Southeast Asian consumers with similar payment and banking needs.

candidates.name: Akulaku
candidates.description: Focuses on providing e-commerce-linked financial services and credit solutions for consumers in Southeast Asia.
candidates.rationale: Both operate Southeast Asian consumer platforms combining e-commerce with digital financial services and credit for overlapping users.

candidates.name: Blibli
candidates.description: An Indonesian e-commerce marketplace that integrates payment and logistics solutions for its user base.
candidates.rationale: Blibli directly overlaps Shopee as a Southeast Asian e-commerce marketplace serving online shoppers and merchants, with integrated payments and logistics.

candidates.name: Block, Inc.
candidates.description: A diversified technology conglomerate that offers peer-to-peer payments and retail services through a unified financial ecosystem.
candidates.rationale: Block primarily provides payments and merchant financial tools, not a consumer e-commerce marketplace like Shopee; buyers would not evaluate them for the same job.

candidates.name: Nubank
candidates.description: A large-scale digital banking platform that focuses on user-centric financial services similar to the ambitions of SeaMoney.
candidates.rationale: Nubank’s digital banking services overlap SeaMoney’s core consumer financial-services offering and address similar users and financial jobs to be done.

candidates.name: VNG Corporation
candidates.description: A prominent Vietnamese digital company offering a portfolio of internet services including digital payments and entertainment.
candidates.rationale: Both are Southeast Asian consumer internet companies with overlapping digital entertainment and payment services, targeting similar consumers and commercial partners.

candidates.name: BigPay group
candidates.description: Offers mobile-based financial management and digital payments, serving as a boutique fintech competitor in the same geographic region.
candidates.rationale: BigPay’s consumer digital payments and financial-management products overlap SeaMoney, serving similar Southeast Asian users and payment needs.

candidates.name: Ascend Money Group
candidates.description: Operates one of the largest fintech and digital payment networks in the Southeast Asian region.
candidates.rationale: Ascend Money’s digital wallets and payment network overlap SeaMoney’s Southeast Asian digital financial services, serving similar consumers and merchants.
